dict.string: PitStop uses your location to track your run, show nearby partner businesses, and route you to Off-Peak Quests.
PitStop keeps tracking your run and checks you in at quest businesses even when your phone is locked.
PitStop compares your step cadence with GPS speed to verify quest runs are real.
PitStop reads heart rate, workouts, steps, and running distance to show live heart rate and score your effort relative to your own baseline.
PitStop saves completed quest runs to Health as running workouts with their route.
PitStop connects directly to a nearby business's phone to share quest offers, arrival times, and check-ins. Health data is never shared.
